body:
Our angels are always there to guide us. We need only to listen for them. When you need to reach out to a power greater than your own, hold tight to your angel and allow it channel the energy of your prayers and intentions.

These angels are particularly beneficial to use when you are asking for guidance or support. By helping to surround you with loving, peaceful energies, the angels will provide comfort during difficult periods of life. That’s why a clear quartz angel makes a perfect gift for your loved ones. When you want your loved one to know that you care, give them the gift of blessings. In purifying the mind and spirit of negative energy, the clear quartz angel brings much needed stress relief to a heavy spirit.

Work with a clear quartz angel when you need to reprogram your spirit with positive habits. Clear quartz is a stone that helps you to not only cleanse the spirit and amplify your spiritual power, but also to program your intentions. When you know that you want to open yourself up to receive guidance from the highest realms of the universe, set your intention to accept the direction you feel called to follow. With the clarity that a clear quartz angel instills, you can recognize and embrace the path of that you were destined to travel.

Due to their nature, each one will be different in shape, size, pattern and color--but each is so special.
